property.title: Meridian Family Home
property.summary: A bright 3-bedroom home on a quiet Meridian street, close to schools and parks.

content.title: Meridian Family Home
content.lead: A calm street, a fenced yard and a floor plan that grows with the family.
paragraphs: Three bedrooms, two and a half baths and a dedicated home office make this Meridian home easy to live in from the first week.
The kitchen opens to the living room, with quartz counters and an island that ends up being where everyone stands. Schools, parks and community pool access are all minutes away.
